bullets: ALLERGY RELIEF MEDICATION: 24-count package of Benadryl Allergy Tablets for allergy relief help to alleviate symptoms associated with allergies such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy throat or nose, and itchy/watery eyes

ANTIHISTAMINE TABLETS: This allergy medicine temporarily provides relief of hay fever and other upper respiratory symptoms such as sneezing and runny nose. It also provides relief from common allergens such as tree pollen, dust, mold and pet dander

COLD SYMPTOM RELIEF: The antihistamine tablets with diphenhydramine hydrochloride feature an effective and powerful formula that works when you need it most. The tablets for multi-symptom relief help tackle both cold and allergy symptoms
DIPHENHYDRAMINE HCl FORMULA: Benadryl allergy medicine is formulated with 25 mg of diphenhydramine hydrochloride, an antihistamine that works to help provide allergy and upper respiratory relief

POWERFUL ALLERGY & COLD RELIEF IN JUST 1 PILL: Adults & children 12+, take one to two allergy tablets every four to six hours. Children ages 6-12, take one allergy medicine tablet every four to six hours. Do not give more than six doses in 24 hours
